worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.summary: Spin a disc of water in the palm and hurl throwing stars on a fixed beat: the next star leaves on schedule even while the previous one is still in flight, so several can share the air. Each star settles its own special damage and refreshes the soak; the star count (2-5) follows level, Special Attack and Speed. The action closes only after the last flight ends. The focused form throws fewer, heavier, truer stars; the spread form throws one more and denser.
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.use.0: A mid-range burst of water stars
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.use.1: Soak a target again and again with a stream of stars
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.use.2: Throw more stars in the spread form, fewer and heavier in the focused form
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.descript: Each water star deals about %1$s special damage on a hit, with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

This volley throws %1$s stars about %2$s s apart on a fixed beat, without waiting for the previous one to vanish; each flies and settles on its own, and the action closes only after the last flight ends.
It reaches %1$s blocks, flying at %2$s blocks/tick with about %3$s degrees of spread.
Each hit soaks the target for %1$s, lowering its movement speed by 6%%; further hits refresh the duration.
Focused: one star fewer (at least 2), each 1.3x, spread 0.6x - fewer, heavier, truer stars; at the cost of +1 tick between stars, +2 ticks recovery and +6 ticks cooldown.
Spread: one star more (at most 5), each 0.85x, a wider spread and a faster recovery.
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.growth.0: At level %1$s each star rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.growth.1: At level %1$s each star rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.watershuriken.preferen: On: one star fewer (at least 2), each 1.3x, spread 0.6x, at the cost of +1 tick between stars, +2 ticks recovery and +6 ticks cooldown. Off (spread): one star more (at most 5), 0.85x each, a wider spread and a faster recovery.
It throws only at targets within this distance; the range is long, so larger values mean opening from further out.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this volley; off: it ranks as an ordinary candidate.
